hypothesis: PHASE-2 experiment #1+#4 (RESUME.md phase-2 ranked list): the FULL combination — time_limit=3 + or_max fusion + soft-threshold 0.2 + --cam-smooth-bins 2, soft-scale 0.8, fine-tuned from the tl=3 topo base (run 611), 200 iterations, --gps-eval, --calibrators (MANDATORY for or_max), session 20250812_165739. TRACKER CONFIG: time_limit=time_limit_max=3, max_sensors=6, lock bar 0.25, P_cam smoothed +/-2 bins. Analytic pre-checks: same 90.00% lock coverage as run 610, but tl=3 lets the tracker survive the residual [10, 8, 3] gaps' first 3 steps each — oracle-policy accuracy upper bound 98.46% vs run 610's 96.92% (diag_phase2_coverage.py section (c)), giving 3.5pp of headroom above the 95% target instead of 1.9pp. Eval metric unchanged (GT node activated while tracked) — comparable to all prior runs; the tracker-internal time_limit change is design, not metric. Exact command saved at experiments/run612/cmd.sh.
findings: MISSED THE PROJECTION, but for a diagnosable and valuable reason: best accuracy 94.20% at iter 39 — 0.8pp BELOW run 610 (95.00%) and far under the 98.46% oracle bound — at a remarkable **1.52 sensors/step** (baseline 91.30% at 1.49), vs 4.94 for run 610 and ~5.2 for typical tl=1 runs. The oracle bound assumes a policy that always activates the GT node; the REAL objective also pays sensor_rew=-0.25 per active sensor (hardcoded, src/core/iobt_environment.py:45). Under tl=1, wide activation was forced — missing-state churn made accuracy pressure dominate. tl=3 removed that pressure, so PPO moved to a new optimum on the SAME reward: slash energy 3.3x and coast on stale tracking, accepting a small accuracy cost. In other words tl=3's slack was spent on energy, not accuracy — the policy is optimizing exactly what it was told to. TAKEAWAYS: (1) run 612 is the best energy-efficiency result in project history by a wide margin (94.20% @ 1.52 sensors — run 610 needs 3.3x the energy for +0.8pp); if the deployment metric values battery, this checkpoint may be PREFERABLE to run 610's. (2) To convert tl=3 headroom into accuracy (the 97% goal), the energy/accuracy balance must be rebalanced: make sensor_rew configurable (e.g. --sensor-rew flag) and fine-tune run 613 from the 611 base with a weaker penalty (-0.05..-0.10) — projected to trade sensors/step back up toward 3-4 for accuracy in the 96-98% band given the 98.46% bound. (3) The tl=3 obs/action space and base checkpoint work end-to-end (this run restored from 611 cleanly and trained stably; same peak-then-decay shape, best at iter 39).
